raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

In modernbert_fp8 unit test, use W8A8 fp8 linear kernel instead of W8A16 on XPU to align with CUDA and make it pass.

## Claims

- On XPU, this ut will call W8A16 fp8 linear kernel `XPUW8A16FP8LinearKernel` and fail.
- On CUDA, this ut calls the W8A8 kernel `CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` by default, and it can pass. Using W8A16 kernel `MarlinFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` will also make the ut fail on cuda.
- This PR uses `XPUW8A8FP8LinearKernel` on XPU by setting `"linear_backend": "xpu"` in this case to resolve the issue.

## Validation
### On XPU
to reproduce:
```
pytest -s -v tests/models/language/pooling_mteb_test/test_modernbert_fp8.py::test_modernbert_online_fp8_mteb
```

result before this PR:
```
(EngineCore pid=38669) INFO 10-23 03:28:27 [__init__.py:808] Selected XPUW8A16FP8LinearKernel for Fp8PerTensorOnlineLinearMethod
...
FAILED tests/models/language/pooling_mteb_test/test_modernbert_fp8.py::test_modernbert_online_fp8_mteb - AssertionError: diff=0.00333914 tol=0.002 model=Alibaba-NLP/gte-modernbert-base (st=0.748193353, vllm=0.7448542169290193)
```

result after this PR:
```
(EngineCore pid=39530) INFO 10-23 06:15:41 [__init__.py:808] Selected XPUW8A8FP8LinearKernel for Fp8PerTensorOnlineLinearMethod
...
PASSED
```

### On CUDA
By default, this ut passed.

<details>
<summary> Reproduction and results when using W8A16 linear kernel on cuda </summary>

To reproduce:
```
vllm serve Alibaba-NLP/gte-modernbert-base \
  --runner pooling --trust-remote-code \
  --quantization fp8_per_tensor \
  --linear-backend marlin --enforce-eager \
  --no-enable-chunked-prefill --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --port 8000 &

cd vllm # the root path of your vllm project

python3 - <<'EOF'
import openai
from tests.models.language.pooling_mteb_test.mteb_embed_utils import (
    OpenAIClientMtebEncoder, run_mteb_embed_task, MTEB_EMBED_TASKS)

client = openai.OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", api_key="EMPTY")
score = run_mteb_embed_task(
    OpenAIClientMtebEncoder("Alibaba-NLP/gte-modernbert-base", client), MTEB_EMBED_TASKS)
base = 0.748193353
print("STS12:", score, "diff:", base - score, "pass(<2e-3):", base - score < 2e-3)
EOF
```

Result:
```
STS12: 0.7448741839970403 diff: 0.0033191690029596987 pass(<2e-3): False
```

</details>


<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

nodes.body: Could you take a look? many thanks @jikunshang @noooop
I feel W8A16 should have better accuracy than W8A8?

> I feel W8A16 should have better accuracy than W8A8?

It could be. But the ut failure here is probably not caused by kernel accuracy, but related to **which kernel is used to calculate the reference score**.

As mentioned above, this case also failed on cuda when W8A16 was used.

here is the score summary for a clearer comparison:
```
reference: 0.748193353
XPU W8A16: 0.7448422 (fail)
XPU W8A8: 0.7494126 (pass)
CUDA W8A16: 0.7448861 (fail)
CUDA W8A8: 0.7474482 (pass)
```

So I suppose the hard-coded reference was actually calculated with W8A8 on cuda.

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #96840](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96840) for commit `5080f5a7897f`.

ℹ️ This PR is 2 commits behind upstream `main`. Merged upstream `main` into this branch as `5080f5a7897f` before starting CI. Pull the branch before pushing more changes.

files.patch:
@@ -54,6 +54,12 @@ def _assert_modernbert_online_fp8(model) -> None:
         assert isinstance(linear.quant_method, Fp8PerTensorOnlineLinearMethod), (
             f"{name} was not quantized with online FP8"
         )
+        if current_platform.is_xpu():
+            from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm.xpu import (
+                XPUW8A8FP8LinearKernel,
+            )
+
+            assert isinstance(linear.quant_method.fp8_linear, XPUW8A8FP8LinearKernel)
 
 
 @pytest.mark.flaky(reruns=2)
@@ -67,11 +73,15 @@ def test_modernbert_online_fp8_mteb(hf_runner, vllm_runner, monkeypatch) -> None
     def check_online_fp8(vllm_model) -> None:
         vllm_model.apply_model(_assert_modernbert_online_fp8)
 
+    vllm_extra_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {"quantization": "fp8_per_tensor"}
+    if current_platform.is_xpu():
+        vllm_extra_kwargs["kernel_config"] = {"linear_backend": "xpu"}
+
     mteb_test_embed_models(
         hf_runner,
         vllm_runner,
         MODEL_INFO,
-        vllm_extra_kwargs={"quantization": "fp8_per_tensor"},
+        vllm_extra_kwargs=vllm_extra_kwargs,
         # Account for Online FP8 kernel variance across GPU architectures.
         atol=2e-3,
         vllm_model_callback=check_online_fp8,
